commands.commandLine: powershell.exe -Command '$x=(Get-Content .'"\\REFERENCE_BINARY.txt -Raw).Trim(); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .\\probe | Out-Null; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Resolve-Path .\\probe).Path+'\\basic.csv', \"h1,h2"'`na,2`nb,1`n", [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); function RunProbe($name,$arguments){ $out=".'"\\probe\\"'$name.out"; $err=".'"\\probe\\"'$name.err"; $p=Start-Process -FilePath $x -ArgumentList $arguments -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru; $ob=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path $out)); $eb=[IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path $err)); Write-Host "--- $name exit=$($p.ExitCode) stdout=$([BitConverter]::ToString($ob)) stderr=$([BitConverter]::ToString($eb))"; if($ob.Length){ [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($ob) | Write-Host }; if($eb.Length){ [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($eb) | Write-Host } }; RunProbe '"'count' @('count','.\\probe\\basic.csv'); RunProbe 'headers' @('headers','.\\probe\\basic.csv'); RunProbe 'select' @('select','h2','.\\probe\\basic.csv'); RunProbe 'slice' @('slice','-s','1','-l','1','.\\probe\\basic.csv'); RunProbe 'badselect' @('select','dne','.\\probe\\basic.csv'); RunProbe 'noargs' @(); RunProbe 'version' @('--version')"
